evidence.quote: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer

observations.why: The suite asserting a behavioral guarantee frames testing as the craft that verifies correct functioning — competence as the appealed-to good.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion

observations.why: Instrumentalizing the memory as a vehicle for the test assertion frames the probe as a tool of verification — competence, the mastery of correct behavior, is the motive the text carries.
